venue_elimination.downtown_kumo_bar: Peanuts on half the rolls and peanut dipping sauce with every set; fails Cyrus's allergy.
venue_elimination.downtown_silver_reed: Fish in every roll, even the garden roll and the miso; fails Mina's vegetarian diet.
venue_elimination.downtown_hinoki_table: Cream cheese in nearly every roll and the house sauce; safe but costs a star for Roxy's dairy intolerance (2 stars max).
venue_elimination.downtown_cedar_line: $$, one tier over Maya's $ budget; costs a star (2 stars max).
venue_elimination.downtown_koi_counter: $, sushi, meat-free section, no peanuts, no dairy at all. Meets every constraint.

notes: Clean one-feature-per-decoy design: each decoy fails exactly one constraint, and Koi Counter's reviews cover all of them explicitly. Fair, perhaps slightly easy once the four constraints are spotted.
Mina's vegetarian need is the most hidden clue: she says she'll be happy with 'whatever', and Cyrus has to state it for her. Good misdirection, and it is still stated clearly enough.
Hinoki Table and Cedar Line are the two soft traps (2 stars each), which gives a nice gradient instead of only deal-breakers.
Small-talk lines (roxy's three new things, the trip fund, the milkshake incident) add flavour without hiding clues unfairly. The milkshake joke supports the dairy clue.
Koi Counter's second review says 'still no milk', and 'still' reads a little oddly, as if it follows an earlier review. Minor wording only.
